mapper.select: select count(*) as event_count, coalesce(sum(t.bytes_up), 0) as bytes_up, coalesce(sum(t.bytes_down), 0) as bytes_down, coalesce(sum(t.bytes_up + t.bytes_down), 0) as total_bytes, count(distinct s.user_id) as distinct_users, count(distinct t.mac) as distinct_macs, count(distinct t.session_id) as distinct_sessions, count(distinct t.node_id) as distinct_nodes, count(distinct t.device_code) as distinct_devices from t_traffic_log t left join t_session s on s.session_id = t.session_id

select from_unixtime( floor(unix_timestamp(t.log_time) / #{criteria.bucketSeconds}) * #{criteria.bucketSeconds} ) as bucket_time, count(*) as event_count, coalesce(sum(t.bytes_up), 0) as bytes_up, coalesce(sum(t.bytes_down), 0) as bytes_down, coalesce(sum(t.bytes_up + t.bytes_down), 0) as total_bytes from t_traffic_log t left join t_session s on s.session_id = t.session_id
group by bucket_time order by bucket_time

select
cast(s.user_id as char)
t.mac
cast(t.session_id as char)
cast(t.node_id as char)
t.device_code
t.dst_ip
cast(t.dst_port as char)
t.sni
t.protocol
as dimension_key, count(*) as event_count, coalesce(sum(t.bytes_up), 0) as bytes_up, coalesce(sum(t.bytes_down), 0) as bytes_down, coalesce(sum(t.bytes_up + t.bytes_down), 0) as total_bytes from t_traffic_log t left join t_session s on s.session_id = t.session_id
and s.user_id is not null
and t.dst_port is not null
and t.sni is not null and t.sni != ''
and t.protocol is not null and t.protocol != ''
group by dimension_key order by total_bytes desc, event_count desc, dimension_key limit #{criteria.topLimit}
